items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: Ed Williams was a sharp fellow, the fellow who was the leader of the band. He had a big house with all the musicians, just a room there with him.

ctx.x: Tell where you got it from or go to jail.

Ed Williams was a sharp fellow, the fellow who was the leader of the band. He had a big house with all the musicians, just a room there with him. He'd give parties, you know. And he had that liquor hidden around there. See like I lived there, I'd order me a court from Monroe. That's mine, you see. When he'd come I'd give it to him, see. The guitar player, he'd order a court. He'd come and give it to Ed. All of us have our own whiskey, you know. You'd have about seven eight quarts of whiskey in the same house.…
